youtube_title: Why Traffic Jams Appear Out of Nowhere
youtube_description:
No crash, no roadwork - so why did traffic stop? In 2008 researchers put 22 cars on a circular track and watched a jam appear out of nothing. Here's the physics of phantom traffic jams.

Visuals are a computer simulation (Intelligent Driver Model) re-creating the experiment's setup, not footage of it.

Sources:
- Sugiyama et al. (2008), New J. Phys. 10 033001 - https://doi.org/10.1088/1367-2630/10/3/033001
- Stern et al. (2018), Transp. Res. C - https://arxiv.org/abs/1705.01693
- Schoenhof & Helbing, Empirical features of congested traffic - https://arxiv.org/abs/cond-mat/0408138
- Kerner et al., congestion features in USA, UK, Germany - https://arxiv.org/abs/1012.5160
